patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Salesforce Commerce Cloud only if your buying job matches “Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; ” rather than Shopware's shape. Choose Shopware only if your buying job matches “Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$6” rather than Salesforce Commerce Cloud's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Salesforce Commerce Cloud is shaped for Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV- whereas Shopware is shaped for Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopware share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; enterprise SaaS landscape, not an SMB Shopify subs; Shopware is Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Rise from ~$660/mo; Evolve from €2400/mo; Beyond quote..
- Company-size focus: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (mid-market, enterprise) vs Shopware (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Shopware — Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV.

Limitations — Salesforce Commerce Cloud: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Implementation is a multi-month SI programme, not a weekend theme install; Shopware: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV; Rise commercial floor is high versus WooCommerce core + hosting.

Poor-fit cases: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet · Shopware is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Community Edition Fair Usage pushes paid plans above ~€1M GMV · Avoid Salesforce Commerce Cloud if you actually need Shopware's motion (Symfony open-source commerce — Community Edition free (Fair Usage ~€1M GMV); Ris)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
